_meta.title: Hebrews — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 13 chapters of Hebrews. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 58 Hebrews); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-3, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV, except whole-clause wrapping parentheses (10:23) removed for clean standalone display. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.plain: The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the exact expression of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.

verses.text: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.plain: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.

verses.text: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.plain: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called 'Today,' so that none of you is hardened by sin's deceit.

verses.text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.plain: For the word of God is alive and active, sharper than any two-edged sword. It cuts deep — dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow — and it judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

verses.text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.plain: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one who was tempted in every way, just as we are — yet he did not sin.

verses.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.plain: So let us come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

verses.text: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.plain: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him,

verses.text: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
verses.plain: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It reaches behind the curtain into God's very presence,

verses.text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.plain: So he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

verses.text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.plain: For I will forgive their wrongdoing and remember their sins no more.

verses.text: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verses.plain: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,

verses.text: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.plain: so Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

verses.text: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; for he is faithful that promised;
verses.plain: Let us hold tightly to the hope we profess, without wavering, for the one who promised is faithful.

verses.text: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.plain: And let us consider how we can spur one another on toward love and good deeds,

verses.text: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.plain: not neglecting to meet together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another — and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

verses.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.plain: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

verses.text: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.plain: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

verses.text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.plain: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that holds us back and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us,

verses.text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.plain: fixing our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.text: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.plain: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, though, it produces a harvest of peace and righteousness for those who have been trained by it.

verses.text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.plain: Keep your life free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, 'I will never leave you, nor forsake you.'

verses.text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.plain: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
